instructions: Use Library to look up current notes. Search first, then read the matching file. Do not guess facts about the owner. The available library is default.

tools.name: library_search
tools.description: Search the owner's Library for notes and documents. Returns file references to read next.

tools.name: library_read
tools.description: Read a text file using its exact relative Library path returned by search or listing.

tools.name: library_list
tools.description: List up to 20 files under a Library path prefix. Use an empty prefix for the root.
